title: Yamraj ko Mahadev ne kyun roka?

characters.Markandeya: a thin 16-year-old Indian boy sage, shaved head with a small tuft, bare chest, rudraksha beads, saffron dhoti, gentle devoted face
characters.Mahadev: Lord Shiva, blue-grey skin, third eye on the forehead, crescent moon in matted hair with Ganga flowing from it, snake around the neck, trident, tiger-skin garment, powerful calm presence
characters.Yamraj: Yamraj the god of death, dark green-black skin, tall golden crown, thick moustache, red and black royal robes, riding a black buffalo, holding a glowing noose and a mace

lines.speak: सोलह साल, बस इतनी लिखी थी उस लड़के की उम्र।
lines.show: Solah *saal*, bas itni likhi thi us ladke ki umr.
lines.scene: Close-up of a calendar page torn from an ancient palm leaf manuscript showing the number sixteen, a young boy's worried face reflected beside it, dim lamp light

lines.speak: नाम था मार्कंडेय, और वो दिन-रात महादेव को पुकारता था।
lines.show: Naam tha Markandeya, aur wo din-raat *Mahadev* ko pukarta tha.
lines.scene: Markandeya sitting with folded hands and closed eyes in front of a Shiva lingam under a banyan tree, flowers and a lit diya, soft golden dawn light

lines.speak: आख़िरी दिन आया, तो वो सीधे शिवलिंग से लिपट गया।
lines.show: Aakhri din aaya, to wo seedhe *shivling* se lipat gaya.
lines.scene: Wide shot of Markandeya hugging a large Shiva lingam tightly inside a dark ancient temple, tears on his face, a storm gathering outside the doorway

lines.speak: तभी यमराज आए, भैंसे पर सवार, हाथ में काला पाश लिए।
lines.show: Tabhi *Yamraj* aaye, bhainse par sawar, haath mein kaala paash liye.
lines.scene: Yamraj riding a huge black buffalo through red storm clouds towards a temple, glowing noose in his raised hand, dramatic low angle

lines.speak: नियम साफ़ था, समय पूरा हुआ, तो साथ चलना ही होगा।
lines.show: Niyam saaf tha, samay *poora* hua, to saath chalna hi hoga.
lines.scene: Yamraj standing at the temple entrance stretching his arm towards the boy, stern cold face, glowing noose, long shadows on the stone floor

lines.speak: उसने पाश फेंका, और वो लड़के के साथ शिवलिंग पर भी जा गिरा।
lines.show: Usne paash phenka, aur wo ladke ke saath *shivling* par bhi ja gira.
lines.scene: Glowing noose flying through the air and wrapping around both the boy and the Shiva lingam together, sparks of light, tense action moment

lines.speak: बस, उसी पल धरती काँप उठी।
lines.scene: The temple pillars cracking and the ground trembling, golden light bursting out of the Shiva lingam, dust and flying stones, epic wide shot

lines.speak: शिवलिंग से महादेव प्रकट हुए, आँखों में क्रोध की आग लिए।
lines.show: Shivling se *Mahadev* prakat hue, aankhon mein krodh ki aag liye.
lines.scene: Lord Shiva emerging from the Shiva lingam in blazing light, fierce angry eyes, trident raised, flames and cosmic energy around him, heroic low angle

lines.speak: एक ही प्रहार में यमराज पीछे हट गए।
lines.show: Ek hi *prahar* mein Yamraj peeche hat gaye.
lines.scene: Lord Shiva striking Yamraj with his foot, Yamraj thrown backwards off his buffalo, the noose breaking into sparks, powerful dynamic action

lines.speak: मार्कंडेय बच गया, और उसे सदा सोलह साल का रहने का वरदान मिला।
lines.show: Markandeya bach gaya, aur use sada *solah* saal ka rehne ka vardaan mila.
lines.scene: Lord Shiva placing his hand in blessing on the head of kneeling young Markandeya, warm golden light, peaceful divine mood

lines.speak: तो बताओ, भक्ति बड़ी है या किस्मत?
lines.show: To batao, *bhakti* badi hai ya kismat?
lines.scene: Markandeya standing alone at sunrise on a temple stair holding a diya, calm smile, a glowing path of light ahead of him, hopeful wide shot

caption: Bhakti badi ya kismat? Comment mein batao.
